metrics.name: overall_accuracy
metrics.description: Proportion of test trials with correct old/new judgment (hits + correct rejections / total). Brady et al. (2008) report 0.87 overall accuracy for adult humans on the abstract-stimulus version of the paradigm.

metrics.name: hit_rate
metrics.description: Proportion of OLD test items judged as OLD (true positives). Brady et al. report ~0.92 for adult humans.

metrics.name: false_alarm_rate
metrics.description: Proportion of NEW test items incorrectly judged as OLD (false positives). Brady et al. report ~0.08 for adult humans.
